description: This file contains functions for masking and unmasking parts of markdown text, such as inline code, links, and URLs, with placeholders and later restoring them.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks markdown inline code, angle links, and link URLs by replacing them with placeholders.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Finds all matches of a given regex in text and replaces them with generated placeholders, updating a mapping.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Finds URL links in markdown and replaces them with placeholders, updating a mapping.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Reverts placeholders back to original markdown content using the provided mapping.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Ensures all placeholders are present within the text, returning an error if any are missing.
